nhanes_record.dataset: CDC NHANES body measures: secondary public CSV, 2017–March 2020
nhanes_record.split_unit: CSV row, no verified participant identifiers
limitations: The cohort was screened during model development.
Participant IDs are unavailable in the secondary CSVs.
Anthropometric predictors are closely related to body mass.
Ridge coefficients use the normal equations.

classification.limitations: Uncalibrated margins; OVO pairwise and OVR classwise scores. Stratified intervals condition on fitted models; undefined ratios are recorded as null.

regression.limitations: Fixed-model row bootstrap assumes exchangeability. Subgroup, agreement and calibration statistics are descriptive.

optimization.history_note: The trace uses the median residual intercept until termination. The gap uses a primal upper bound and may be nonmonotonic; the KKT curve shows signed-gradient stationarity.

numerical_dependencies: Python standard library only; pandas, Matplotlib, IPython, tqdm and Colab are presentation/runtime utilities
